summary: Created a 4-phase, 1.75-hour implementation plan for the repo-mode literature-briefing.sh SIGPIPE crash. Root cause confirmed at lines 238-241 and 245-247 (jq whole-object piped into head -1 under set -euo pipefail). Fix direction: jq -c 'first(.entries[] | select(...))' at both sites, removing head from the pipeline. Plan phases: (1) capture pre-fix baseline against the real Logos/Theory sub-index, (2) apply the two-site fix in the source store, (3) audit the 8 remaining head -1 sites, (4) end-to-end verification closing all four verification bars. Plan passes validate-artifact.sh --strict with 0 warnings.
